# Consumer Credit Matters — credit card ABS performance

> Monthly performance of every SEC-registered U.S. credit card master trust, from SEC Form 10-D
> servicer reports: delinquency, charge-offs, payment rate, yield, excess spread and receivables.

## Trusts (one page each)

- [American Express Credit Account Master Trust (AMXCA)](https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/AMXCA/) — data https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/data/AMXCA.json
- [BA Credit Card Trust (BACCT)](https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/BACCT/) — data https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/data/BACCT.json

## Data files

- `https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/data/<TICKER>.json` — a trust's monthly series, latest readings, its note series and definitions
- `https://data.consumercreditmatters.com/abs/credit-card/data/ALL.json` — All Trusts, weighted by receivables
